note: Art direction for Aluxes (AL1): the owner's painterly folk-tale style, in a Yucatán palette (teal-indigo jungle night, fireflies, terracotta, corn gold, Maya blue). The alux is drawn like a Jaina-style painted clay figurine come to life. tools/generate_art.py reads it.
style: A warm, painterly oil-painting illustration for a collectible card game, in a cosy storybook folk-tale style: visible soft brush strokes, rich saturated colours, warm firelight and moonlight against deep teal and indigo jungle shadows, with softly glowing fireflies floating in the dark background. The colours of Yucatán: terracotta, corn gold, Maya blue and jungle green. Characters are gentle, whimsical and a little mischievous, never scary. Kid-friendly. One clear main subject, centred and fully in frame. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, symbols, logos, borders, card frames or watermarks.

subjects.AL1-H01-kitten: the cutest alux of all: even tinier and rounder than the other aluxes, like a soft plush toy come to life, with a straw hat a size too big for him that sits low over huge gentle heavy-lidded dark eyes with a sweet shy look, a big soft round nose, rosy chubby cheeks, warm terracotta-brown skin, a tiny white cotton shirt, a little red woven sash with Maya-blue patterns, tiny huarache sandals. Not a king, no crown, no halo, no glowing robes. He sits in the little dark doorway of his doll-sized house of stacked grey limestone with a tiny palm-thatch roof, at the edge of the cornfield, hugging a golden ear of corn almost as big as himself, with a small friendly spotted dog curled up beside the doorstep and a firefly glowing on the brim of his hat. Cosy, tender, captivating.
subjects.AL1-H01-bigcat: the cutest alux of all: even tinier and rounder than the other aluxes, like a soft plush toy come to life, with a straw hat a size too big for him that sits low over huge gentle heavy-lidded dark eyes with a sweet shy look, a big soft round nose, rosy chubby cheeks, warm terracotta-brown skin, a tiny white cotton shirt, a little red woven sash with Maya-blue patterns, tiny huarache sandals. Not a king, no crown, no halo, no glowing robes. Now he is the proud little caller of the rain: he stands on the palm-thatch roof of his doll-sized limestone house with his chest puffed out and both tiny arms raised to the sky, a content smile on his face, as the first warm rain falls in glittering drops over the tall corn around him, his small spotted dog looking up at him adoringly from the doorstep. Proud and funny, still tiny and adorable.
subjects.AL1-D04: a small alux, a knee-high Maya spirit of the cornfield: a stout, round little figure that looks like a painted clay figurine come to life, with warm terracotta-brown skin, a big soft round nose, heavy-lidded gentle dark eyes, chubby cheeks, a wide sweet smile, a loose white cotton shirt and rolled-up white trousers, a red woven sash with a few Maya-blue painted patterns, leather huarache sandals, and a wide round straw hat. Gentle, whimsical and a little mischievous, never scary. This alux has only just been shaped from red-brown clay by the healer: his surface is still wet clay with visible thumbprints and a few fine cracks, one arm still stiff, and he is sitting up for the very first time on a woven palm mat inside a candle-lit palm-thatched hut, blinking with wonder, a little clay bowl of corn kernels and a lit candle beside him.
subjects.AL1-D09: a small alux, a knee-high Maya spirit of the cornfield: a stout, round little figure that looks like a painted clay figurine come to life, with warm terracotta-brown skin, a big soft round nose, heavy-lidded gentle dark eyes, chubby cheeks, a wide sweet smile, a loose white cotton shirt and rolled-up white trousers, a red woven sash with a few Maya-blue painted patterns, leather huarache sandals, and a wide round straw hat. Gentle, whimsical and a little mischievous, never scary. He stands among the tall corn stalks at night with two fingers to his lips and cheeks puffed out, whistling hard, his straw hat pushed back, a small slingshot tucked into his sash, while a startled coati and a fat raccoon in the corn turn tail and run away with their eyes wide. Moonlight and fireflies. No musical notes or symbols.
